name: Double Jump System
description: Give players a second chance in mid-air with a responsive, configurable double jump system.
details: A lightweight movement upgrade that tracks airborne jumps, resets cleanly on landing, and lets you tune the feel from one configuration module.

scripts.name: DoubleJump.client.lua
scripts.description: Input, jump state and landing reset.

scripts.name: Config.lua
scripts.description: Tune the second jump without editing logic.

instructions: Create a ModuleScript named Config inside ReplicatedStorage.
Adjust JumpPower in Config.lua and test with Play mode.
notes: This example uses the default Humanoid jump system.
